completeness_contract.trigger: When asked whether anything is missing, forgotten, pending, contradictory, stale, or next.
completeness_contract.drift_rule: A stale or contradictory module is a finding, not permission to silently overwrite its owner.
completeness_contract.write_rule: Never create another canonical memory file for a new idea. Write it to its owning module/source and register that source in ROOT only if it is a genuinely new module.
completeness_contract.required_action: Read ROOT, then expand every required module in ordinal order; do not answer from chat memory alone.
